consumer: The PICKUP input loop in pickup.cpp::pick_up_from_items, which asks 'which ground items did the player select to pick up?' and acts on that choice by moving them into inventory
scope: items reachable in the ground stack at the relevant nearby tile(s) (map::i_at), not the character's own carried items
decisive_source: src/pickup.cpp::pick_up_from_items registers UP/DOWN/RIGHT/CONFIRM/QUIT on input_context("PICKUP") and runs a redraw/handle_input loop, marking selection and finalizing on CONFIRM — an interactive menu answered through the real active input loop
divergence: A tile holds two identical-typeId stacks (e.g. two cans of beans); the player selects only the second. A snapshot/index-derived shortcut that picks 'a can of beans' grabs the wrong one (or both), exposing that only the real selection loop preserves which entry the player chose
